validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE CONFIRMED. This branch is a real, currently-live item in PJSC Gazprom's own Pskov Oblast gasification-programme map (gazprommap.ru/pskovskaya/, point-22: 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС «Опочка» Псковской области', done=0, checked 2026-09-15), independently corroborated by a 2022 regional-press report quoting the Pskov Oblast tariffs-and-energy committee chair on the same object's schedule (design 2025, construction-start 2027) -- gubernia.media, 2022-05-14. Not a GEM-only or hallucinated entity; not one of the roster's flagged duplicate families (P2707/P7537, P3990-92, P4094-96) -- no evidence this row double-counts another PID. Two caveats are filed as separate concerns below: (1) PipelineType classification looks wrong (distribution vs transmission); (2) the specific claim that the branch ORIGINATES at Pushkinskiye Gory is not independently source-confirmed, though it is geographically plausible given the roster's Bezhanitsy->Novorzhev->Pushkinskiye Gory->Opochka chain.

validity.researcher_notes: The object is named 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС «Опочка»' -- a branch/tie-in line TERMINATING AT a gas-distribution station (ГРС), which per this batch's own transmission/distribution test is upstream TRUNK plant (operated by a Gazprom Transgaz subsidiary at 5.4-7.5 MPa), not the downstream 'межпоселковый'/'внутрипоселковый' network PAST the ГРС that Gazprom Gazoraspredeleniye runs. The same gazprommap.ru programme lists a SEPARATE, distinct downstream object at this exact GRS -- point-23, 'Газопровод межпоселковый ГРС «Опочка» - г. Опочка' -- which IS the true distribution-side pipeline (a different GEM row would need to exist for it, or it is out of GEM's scope; not this batch's concern to add it, just to note the distinction). This mirrors the same misclassification GEM's own researchers already flagged in prose on sibling отвод rows in this batch (P4085, P4092, P4093 all carry notes to the effect of 'this looks like a distribution pipeline because it starts at a GRS' -- exactly backwards per the test: starting AT a GRS as the trunk side, or terminating AT one as the отвод side, is the transmission signal, not the distribution one). I did not find a source that explicitly classifies this object as either 'distribution' or 'transmission' by name, so I am not staging a PipelineType fill -- flagging this as a concern for a researcher/QC pass to adjudicate against the routes-repo geometry or a Glavgosexpertiza approval, per the batch's 'flag, do not reclassify' instruction.

I checked every comparable 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС <X>' entry on the same map (Струги Красные/point-18, Пустошка/point-25, Идрица/point-27, Гдов/point-30) and NONE of them state an origin either -- the source document's own naming convention is destination-only for these branch objects, so this is a systemic gap across the whole отвод family in this batch (P4149, P4150, P4156, P4166, P4167, P4172), not a defect unique to P4156. Separately, the same map documents 'point-8': ГРС «Пушкинские Горы» - р.п. Красногородск -- i.e. Pushkinskiye Gory's own GRS is independently confirmed to exist and to already anchor a DIFFERENT downstream corridor, toward Красногородск (west), not Opochka (south). This doesn't rule out Pushkinskiye Gory also being this branch's upstream tie-in point (a GRS/compressor point can anchor more than one onward line), and it is geographically consistent with the roster's stated chain Bezhanitsy->Novorzhev->Pushkinskiye Gory->Opochka, but I found no document that actually names Pushkinskiye Gory as this specific branch's start. Not escalating this to a hard 'concern' because the entity and its true endpoint (Opochka) are solid and nothing contradicts the Pushkinskiye Gory claim -- it is unconfirmed, not disproven -- but it should not be read as source-verified either.
